entry.title: Personnel Committee: the meeting of 3 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Personnel Committee unanimously approved the data collector job description as written, unchanged from its 2024 grade. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x4HDKD0Ol7c), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
